summary: Tested the Portal 'I miei Documenti e Visite' area, the therapy endpoints and the richer Trova Specialista cards. Backend: 8/8 new pytest pass (therapy rows include Amoxicillina and Paracetamolo from the otitis report; therapy PDF is a valid %PDF named Promemoria_terapia_Aurora_Ricci.pdf; unlinked or invalid pid returns 404 for both endpoints; doctor 403; unauthenticated 401/403; portal/me reports have no _id; referto PDF works; directory cards have bio_short (180 chars max), services (3 max) and services_count). Frontend (genitore.demo) passes end to end: sidebar link and profile-documents both go to /portale/documenti; tabs update ?tab=; Visite shows 2026 with 3 visits (otitis plus 'Bilancio di salute' badge), 'In parole semplici' opens, Referto PDF downloads, 5 checkpoints and the signed docs list show; Prescrizioni shows 2 rx rows and Promemoria terapia downloads; Ricevute shows docs-receipts-empty (Aurora has 0 receipts); /portale/referti and /portale/ricevute redirect correctly; the report notification goes to documenti?tab=visite; the Appuntamenti section renders. Trova Specialista: chips tutti/Pediatria, search filter and empty state, card bio and 3 services (+1), view opens the dialog (?medico=tiziana-foti) and Esc closes it, book opens the booking dialog with Aurora and Dott.ssa Foti preselected. Responsive 390/768/1440: no horizontal page overflow; at 390 the tablist scrolls (601px content in 358px). No page errors.

minor.issue: The 404-when-no-rows branch was not verified end to end: the demo parent has only Aurora, who has therapy rows. The code path looks correct.
N+1 pattern: one find_one per linked child for the cf_hash match, and one per group for the doctor name. Fine at the current scale.

issues: The 'Bilancio di salute' badge only checks template_name. The 12 Aug 2026 visit has motivo 'Bilancio di salute' but an empty template_name, so it gets no badge. Consider also testing motivo or checkpoint linkage.
The newest visit shows clinic 'Studio' (fallback) because its clinic is empty.
The tablist scrolls horizontally but the third tab is cut off with no fade or scroll hint. Optional: add a gradient edge.
'Richiedi appuntamento' wraps onto 2 lines in the 2-column button grid at 390 and 1440. Optional: shorten it to 'Prenota' or stack the buttons.
The bio falls back to 'Medico della rete MantMed.' because the founder bio is empty (data, not a bug).
'Data desiderata' uses the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn Calendar.

action_items: Optional: make the Bilancio badge detection also use motivo or checkpoint data
Optional: add a scroll affordance on the mobile tablist and shorten the card CTA label
Optional: replace the native date input in RequestDialog with the shadcn Calendar
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentsArea Prescriptions uses g[0].patient.id. The backend aggregates by cf_hash, so this is correct for grouped kids.
Portal.jsx has an import placed after the const declarations (LogoMark/api imports after SECTIONS/LEGACY). Harmless but untidy.
TITLES still contains the referti/ricevute keys, which are unreachable after the legacy redirect (dead code).
The 'In parole semplici' content in Documenti relies on r.riepilogo, so only one visit shows it; the AI simple summary from the overview is not reused here.
